decisions.corrective_action: Manager will receive sensitivity training and a formal warning.

commitments.detail: Sensitivity training focused on preventing retaliation.
Formal written warning issued for retaliatory behavior.
Complainant will be reassigned to a new reporting line to avoid direct supervision by the manager.
Complainant will have no direct supervision from the manager for 90 days.
Notice of the finding and corrective action taken.
Notice and consent required from the insurer regarding the corrective action.
